notes: The widget plays with the app swiped away for a reason that is not a workaround: SideCut keeps a copy of the song you are playing and plays it with a real Android player, in a service the swipe cannot remove. Every player here until now was a WebView, so the swipe killed the only thing making sound.
Pressing play with nothing open starts that player straight away - no app launch, no window, no waiting for a page to answer.
Opening the app hands playback back to it, so the same song never plays twice.
The copy is written once per song, in the app's own storage, and only when the song changes.
With no copy yet - a fresh install that has not played anything - the press behaves exactly as before.
